description:
Field/glasshouse phenotypes of Watkins accessions (heading, height, grain size/weight/quality, senescence,
lodging, rust and mildew scores, morphology). With no arguments, lists the trials (JIC UK 2006-2020, Egypt
2019-2021, Limagrain seedling yellow rust 2020, Kenya/Ethiopia rust 2013) and trait names with units.
Filter by accession (e.g. WATDE0063), exact trait name, trial and/or country.
name: watkins_phenotypes
